system.description:
Master of hellfire and unbreakable contracts. More dangerous to cross than to serve.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Once per day, when a creature damages you, they immediately take 1d10 fire, +1d10 per 6 Warlock levels, as a reaction. No saving throw.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, speak a statement of 10 words or fewer that becomes magically binding on you — if you break it you take 2d6 fire damage. Creatures who witness the oath are compelled to honour any deal made in that moment; breaking a witnessed deal deals 1d6 fire damage to them.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, bind a creature to a spoken contract (Will save against your Class Save DC). Breaking it deals 4d6 fire and marks them — other devils will pursue the oathbreaker.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Mephistopheles in the World of Arneyan wiki.
